System: WVTaTiCr x (x = 0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1) refractory high-entropy alloy coatings on 42-CrMo steel substrate. Processing: Laser cladding using a LYHS series ultra-high-speed laser-cladding machine; powder mixture of W, V, Ta, Ti, Cr (45–105 μm, 99.9% purity) ball-milled for 24 h at 300 r/min (10:1 ball-to-material ratio); laser power 1.4 kW, scanning speed 8 mm/s, spot diameter 6 mm, overlap rate 30–40%, argon protective gas. System: Equimolar AlCoCrFeNi high entropy alloy (HEA). Processing: Stationary friction processing (SFP) using a WC-cylindrical tool (12 mm diameter) at rotational speeds of 400 rpm and 1800 rpm for 5 min duration.
